 Order

This is seventh application on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the BNSS for grant of bail in relation to Crime No. 131/2022, registered at Police Station Uchehra, District Satna for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3) and 342 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 3/4 (2) of the POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act.
The applicant is in jail since 14.02.2022.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that this application may be considered on the ground that despite granting opportunity and directing the trial court to conclude the trial, the trial is not being concluded.

As per the order sheets of the trial court, when the case was fixed for final hearing, an application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. was filed by the prosecution seeking permission to produce some more additional witnesses and that application has been allowed.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, the trial court is directed to NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:17319 2 MCRC-15320-2025 conclude the trial within a period of three months.
It is also directed that the trial be conducted on day-to-day basis because the offence is also committed under the POCSO Act.
It is also to be noted here that the trial is being conducted since 2022 and at the verge of completion of trial, application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. has been moved.

Prima-facie, I Abhishek Tamrakar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193859872/
1 do not find any cause to move that application, but, since that has been allowed, it is the duty of the trial court to conclude the trial.
